Cameron Hamilton, founder of Alliance AI, joins Rubber Duck Thursday to talk about building HALIE, his personal AI agent. We get into the build story, the decisions along the way, and what he learned shipping it.

Rubber Duck Thursday is our weekly, informal stream where we talk about what’s new at GitHub and bring on guests building interesting things.

Jueves de Quack con @acolombiadev y Alejandro Menocal

Descubre GitHub Agentic Workflows: un archivo Markdown, un comando y un agente de IA que actualiza documentación, mejora pruebas y corrige CI desde GitHub Actions. Veremos una demo en vivo que monitorea fuentes, actualiza una página web y abre un Pull Request listo para revisar.
